TileStructure.Forest.correlation_near_tr.statement: Under the standing assumptions of the proof (the data $a\in\mathbb N$, $q$, $K$, $\sigma_1$, $\sigma_2$, $F$, $G$ of `ProofData` on the metric space $X$, which is then a doubling metric measure space, and a tile structure `TileStructure` on $X$ with the default parameters $D=D(a)$, $\kappa=\kappa(a)$, $S=S(X)$), let $n\in\mathbb N$ and let $t$ be a forest of level $n$. (Lemma 7.4.6) Let $u_1,u_2\in t$ with $u_1\ne u_2$ and $\mathcal I(u_1)\le\mathcal I(u_2)$, and let $f_1,f_2:X\to\mathbb C$ be bounded with compact support. Then $$\Big\|\int_X T^*_{\mathfrak T(u_1)}f_1(x)\,\overline{T^*_{\mathfrak T(u_2)\setminus\mathfrak S_0(u_1,u_2)}f_2(x)}\,dx\Big\|\le C_{7.4.6}(a,n)\,\big\|\mathbf 1_{\mathcal I(u_1)}\,S^*_{u_1}f_1\big\|_{L^2}\,\big\|\mathbf 1_{\mathcal I(u_1)}\,S^*_{u_2}f_2\big\|_{L^2},$$ where $T^*_{\mathfrak C}$ is the adjoint Carleson sum over $\mathfrak C$ and $S^*_{u}$ denotes the adjoint boundary operator $t.\mathrm{adjointBoundaryOperator}\,u$.

TileStructure.Forest.thin_scale_impact_p.statement: Under the standing assumptions of the proof (the data $a\in\mathbb N$, $q$, $K$, $\sigma_1$, $\sigma_2$, $F$, $G$ of `ProofData` on the metric space $X$, which is then a doubling metric measure space, and a tile structure `TileStructure` on $X$ with the default parameters $D=D(a)$, $\kappa=\kappa(a)$, $S=S(X)$), let $n\in\mathbb N$ and let $t$ be a forest of level $n$. Let $u_1\in t$ and $J\in\mathcal J_6(u_1)$, and let $\mathfrak p$ be a tile such that the balls $B(c(\mathfrak p),8D^{s(\mathfrak p)})$ and $B(c(J),8D^{s(J)})$ are not disjoint and $s(J)-C_{7.6.3}(a,n)<s(\mathfrak p)$. Then $d(c(\mathfrak p),c(J))<16D^{s(\mathfrak p)+C_{7.6.3}(a,n)+2}$, and there is a cube $J'$ with $J<J'$ and $s(J')=s(J)+1$ together with a tile $\mathfrak p'\in\mathfrak T(u_1)$ such that $\mathcal I(\mathfrak p')\subseteq B(c(J'),100D^{s(J')+1})$.

TileStructure.Forest.thin_scale_impact_k.statement: Under the standing assumptions of the proof (the data $a\in\mathbb N$, $q$, $K$, $\sigma_1$, $\sigma_2$, $F$, $G$ of `ProofData` on the metric space $X$, which is then a doubling metric measure space, and a tile structure `TileStructure` on $X$ with the default parameters $D=D(a)$, $\kappa=\kappa(a)$, $S=S(X)$), let $n\in\mathbb N$ and let $t$ be a forest of level $n$. Let $u_1,u_2\in t$ with $u_1\ne u_2$ and $\mathcal I(u_1)\le\mathcal I(u_2)$, let $\mathfrak p\in\mathfrak T(u_2)\setminus\mathfrak S_0(u_1,u_2)$, let $J\in\mathcal J_6(u_1)$, suppose the balls $B(c(\mathfrak p),8D^{s(\mathfrak p)})$ and $B(c(J),8D^{s(J)})$ are not disjoint, and suppose $s(J)-C_{7.6.3}(a,n)<s(\mathfrak p)$. Then $$2^{Z(n+1)-1}<2^{a(\mathbb c\,a^2(C_{7.6.3}(a,n)+2+1)+9)}\cdot2^{Zn/2},$$ where $Z=Z(a)$ is the default parameter $\mathrm{defaultZ}(a)$ and $\mathbb c$ is the absolute constant $𝕔$. (By the docstring, this relation is later shown to be contradictory.)

TileStructure.Forest.e763.statement: Under the standing assumptions of the proof (the data $a\in\mathbb N$, $q$, $K$, $\sigma_1$, $\sigma_2$, $F$, $G$ of `ProofData` on the metric space $X$, which is then a doubling metric measure space, and a tile structure `TileStructure` on $X$ with the default parameters $D=D(a)$, $\kappa=\kappa(a)$, $S=S(X)$), let $n\in\mathbb N$ and let $t$ be a forest of level $n$. (Equation (7.6.3) of Lemma 7.6.2) Let $u_1,u_2\in t$ with $u_1\ne u_2$ and $\mathcal I(u_1)\le\mathcal I(u_2)$, and let $f:X\to\mathbb C$ be bounded with compact support. Then $$\Big\|P_{\mathcal J_6(u_1)}\big|T^*_{\mathfrak T(u_2)\setminus\mathfrak S_0(u_1,u_2)}f\big|\Big\|_{L^2}\le\sum_{k=\lfloor C_{7.6.3}(a,n)\rfloor}^{2S}\Bigg(\sum_{J\in\mathcal J_6(u_1)}\mu(J)^{-1}\Big(\int_J\sum_{\mathfrak p}\big\|T^*_{\mathfrak p}f(y)\big\|\,d\mu(y)\Big)^2\Bigg)^{1/2},$$ where $P_{\mathcal J_6(u_1)}$ is the approximation by averages on the cubes of $\mathcal J_6(u_1)$, the inner sum runs over $\mathfrak p\in\mathfrak T(u_2)\setminus\mathfrak S_0(u_1,u_2)$ such that $J$ meets $B(c(\mathfrak p),8D^{s(\mathfrak p)})$ and $s(\mathfrak p)=s(J)-k$, and $T^*_{\mathfrak p}$ is the adjoint Carleson operator of the tile $\mathfrak p$.

TileStructure.Forest.e764_postCS.statement: Under the standing assumptions of the proof (the data $a\in\mathbb N$, $q$, $K$, $\sigma_1$, $\sigma_2$, $F$, $G$ of `ProofData` on the metric space $X$, which is then a doubling metric measure space, and a tile structure `TileStructure` on $X$ with the default parameters $D=D(a)$, $\kappa=\kappa(a)$, $S=S(X)$), let $n\in\mathbb N$ and let $t$ be a forest of level $n$. (Equation (7.6.4) of Lemma 7.6.2, after Cauchy–Schwarz) Let $u_1,u_2\in t$ with $u_1\ne u_2$ and $\mathcal I(u_1)\le\mathcal I(u_2)$, and let $f:X\to\mathbb C$ be bounded with compact support. Then $$\Big\|P_{\mathcal J_6(u_1)}\big|T^*_{\mathfrak T(u_2)\setminus\mathfrak S_0(u_1,u_2)}f\big|\Big\|_{L^2}\le\Big(C_{2.1.3}(a)\,2^{11a+2}\sum_{k=\lfloor C_{7.6.3}(a,n)\rfloor}^{2S}D^{-k\kappa/2}\Big)\,\big\|\mathbf 1_{\mathcal I(u_1)}M_{\mathcal B}f\big\|_{L^2},$$ where $M_{\mathcal B}$ is the maximal function (with exponent $1$) over the family of balls $\mathcal B$ used in the forest construction.
